caseName: German Insurance Co. of Freeport v. First National Bank of Boonville
caseNameFull: German Insurance Company of Freeport, Illinois v. First National Bank of Boonville, New York
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Kansas.
attorneys: Mr. A. P. Jetmore for plaintiff in error. Mr. W. PL. Rossington and. Mr. Charles Blood Smith for defendant in error.

opinions.text:

Dismissed on the authority of Oxley Stave Company v. Butler County, 166 U. S. 648; Louisville and Nashville Railroad Company v. Louisville, 166 U. S. 709, and other cases.
